This spirit mirrors the essence of CoBa’s Daughter. She is the modern woman in constant evolution, moving through the world with intention, ambition, and clarity, yet never forgetting to return to herself.
 
 The Daughter’s Journey is not about speed, but direction.  #cobasdaughter #yearofthehorse #bodycare

 Cleanse the past.

videos.author: cobasdaughter.official
videos.caption: The fruit ripens slowly, then releases its outer layers, letting go of what once protected it to reveal the bean within. This quiet transformation is essential. Without shedding, there is no clarity, no depth, no readiness for what comes next. Lunar New Year holds the same promise. As the Year of the Horse begins, we follow nature’s rhythm releasing what the body no longer needs, refining the surface with intention and care. Through gentle exfoliation, yesterday is softened and lifted away, allowing the skin to breathe, reset, and renew. This is not removal, but revelation. #cobasdaughter #yearofthehorse #bodycare

In Vietnam’s Central Highlands, each coffee tree grows with intention, its strength shaped long before the first harvest. The weight of origin is carried in every stage from root to branch, from green fruit to ripened bean. Nothing is accidental. Everything is earned.
 #cobasdaughter #yearofthehorse #bodycare

A reflection of our belief in thoughtful innovation and the courage to lead without losing touch with origin. Like the first step of a long journey, this moment is only the beginning. #cobasdaughter #yearofthehorse #bodyscrub

videos.author: cobasdaughter.official
videos.caption: Today, we return to where it all begins - the Highlands. A land of rolling plateaus, red basalt soil, morning mist, and winds that move slowly but with purpose. In Vietnam, the Highlands are shaped by altitude and time, where sunlight feels gentler, the air runs clearer, and nature grows with quiet intention. From this land, all living things are formed with a certain spirit. Trees take root deeply, growing strong against changing seasons. Creatures born here learn resilience early, steady, enduring, and unafraid of long journeys. Strength is not loud, it is built through patience, persistence, and harmony with the land. This year, we chose the horse as our symbol. Through its eyes, we tell a story of origin, of forward motion grounded in where we come from.
